integrity: The proof is symbolic. The embedded checker uses exact rational arithmetic and independently compares the formula with profile enumeration and direct full-system source-subset enumeration on finite test ranges.
scientific_limitations: For thresholds below the one-step fidelity, the theorem gives an exact one-dimensional integer minimization rather than a single elementary closed form. It is restricted to homogeneous simple random walk on complete bipartite graphs.
title: Exact discounted hitting domination of complete bipartite graphs
